Config.title: Config
Config.description: Stores global configuration settings for the Rádio Vida application, controlling content, appearance, and core functionality.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Config entity.

appName.description: The name of the radio station application.

slogan.description: The tagline or slogan for the radio station.

logoImageUrl.description: URL of the radio's logo image. If provided, hides text name and slogan.

logoSize.description: Size (width and height) of the logo in pixels.

showRadioName.description: Controls the visibility of the radio name text on the hero section.

showRadioSlogan.description: Controls the visibility of the slogan text on the hero section.

showHeroIcon.description: Controls the visibility of the central SVG icon on the hero section.

showRadioLogo.description: Controls the visibility of the uploaded logo image on the hero section.

maintenanceMode.description: Ativa o modo de manutenção, ocultando o site para visitantes e mostrando uma mensagem de 'Voltamos logo'.

showNoticeBar.description: Ativa a barra de avisos no topo do site.

noticeBarFixed.description: Define se a barra de avisos deve ficar fixa no topo durante a rolagem.

noticeBarText.description: O texto a ser exibido na barra de avisos.

noticeBarIcon.description: O ícone da Lucide a ser exibido na barra de avisos.

noticeBarExpiresAt.description: Data e hora (ISO) em que o aviso deve parar de ser exibido.

noticeBarLinkText.description: Texto do link opcional na barra de avisos.

noticeBarLinkUrl.description: URL do link opcional na barra de avisos.

heroBackgroundImageUrl.description: The URL for the hero section background image.

showHeroBackground.description: Define se a imagem de fundo da seção Hero deve ser exibida.

heroBadge1Text.description: Text for the first badge under the main title.

heroBadge1Icon.description: Lucide icon name for the first badge.

showHeroBadge1.description: Controls the visibility of the first hero badge.

heroBadge2Text.description: Text for the second badge under the main title.

heroBadge2Icon.description: Lucide icon name for the second badge.

showHeroBadge2.description: Controls the visibility of the second hero badge.

streamUrl.description: The URL of the live audio stream for the radio.

autoplay.description: Define se a rádio deve começar a tocar automaticamente ao carregar o site.

metadataUrl.description: The URL to fetch dynamic 'Now Playing' metadata.

useDynamicMetadata.description: Whether to use the dynamic metadata URL or static text.

defaultVolume.description: The initial volume for new listeners (0 to 1).

defaultTheme.description: O tema padrão do site (light ou dark).

nowPlayingText.description: The text currently displayed in the 'Now Playing' section (static fallback).

aboutBadge.description: Small text above the about title (e.g., 'Nossa Identidade').

aboutTitle.description: The main heading for the 'About' section.

aboutText.description: The content for the 'About' section on the homepage.

aboutImageUrl.description: The URL for the image displayed in the About section.

showAboutImage.description: Define se a imagem da seção Sobre deve ser exibida.

verseText.description: A prominent Bible verse displayed on the homepage or footer.

showAbout.description: Controls the visibility of the 'About' section on the homepage.

showProgramacao.description: Controls the visibility of the 'Programming' section on the homepage.

showVersiculo.description: Controls the visibility of the main Bible verse section on the homepage.

showNowPlaying.description: Controls the visibility of the 'Now Playing' section on the homepage.

showFooter.description: Master control for the entire footer section.

footerDescription.description: Short description text displayed in the footer.

showFooterDescription.description: Controls the visibility of the brand/description column in the footer.

footerStatusText.description: Texto de status no rodapé (ex: 'Transmitindo Esperança 24h').

footerStatusIcon.description: Ícone da Lucide para o status no rodapé.

showSocial.description: Master control for the social media links section.

showInstagram.description: Controls the visibility of the Instagram link.

showFacebook.description: Controls the visibility of the Facebook link.

showYoutube.description: Controls the visibility of the YouTube link.

showUsefulLinks.description: Controls the visibility of the useful links section in the footer.

showContact.description: Controls the visibility of the contact section in the footer.

copyrightText.description: The copyright notice for the application, typically displayed in the footer.

socialMediaLinks.description: A list of social media profiles associated with the radio station.

usefulLinks.description: A list of custom links for the footer.

Program.title: Program
Program.description: Represents an individual radio program or show within the Rádio Vida broadcast schedule.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Program entity.

horario.description: The broadcast time or schedule description for the program (e.g., 'Segunda a Sexta, 8h às 9h').

name.description: The name or title of the radio program.

presenter.description: The name of the host or presenter for the program.

description.description: A brief description of the program's content or theme.

definition.description: Stores the single global configuration document.
